design: Common first128 CTD-ranked parents split at760; share next380 updates and exact model/Adam checkpoint at1140; four branches select128 more distinct original parents from remaining384 among fixed fit-only CTD top512, grouped into24 contiguous batches16.

rankings.fixed_ctd: First8 candidate batches in original CTD order, matching E08 twice_forced parent list.
rankings.current_render: Top8 batches by mean immediate fit-render loss decrease at shared live step1140.
rankings.stale_render: Top8 batches by same score measured just after first128 splits at step760. Isolates scoring time from merely using render loss.
rankings.random: Uniform8 of24 batches without replacement using SeedSequence([42,909]).

scoring: Frozen20 balanced fit views inherited E06; .8L1+.2(1-SSIM),400px. Each proposed16-parent batch evaluated separately against identical unsplit state; no optimizer updates. Finite scores, stable descending sort ties by original batch index. No holdout/test selection.
commit: All selected128 committed regardless score sign to match exact finalcount10256. Apply batches in ascending original batch index. Candidate batches scored independently, no greedy rescoring or guarantee of additive render gains.
geometry: Fit76 local CTD child partitions and trajectories reused E05; source-opacity normalized weights. No new geometry/partition/deformation learning or physical-mass transport.
controls: CTD, current-render, stale-render and random share exact first-event and step1140 optimizer state, main orders, finalcount and main-update Gaussian integral. Continue checkpoint reused E06 only as context. Ranking requires extra renders: report shared cost separately, no equal total-compute claim.
evaluation: All four selection lists and training frozen before74holdout,20GT and150-frame evaluation. Recompute fixed_ctd arm; compare parent list and numerical metrics to E08 twice_forced as a repeat, not exact CUDA metric equality.
limitations: Single scene/seed, fixed teacher/child geometry and two preset event times
Render ranking is batch-level16 and conditional on CTD top512 pool
Decision20 views belong to fit set, not independent validation
No probe optimization, acceptance threshold, child re-split, merge or full4DGS adaptive densification
Fixed parent/child trajectories, not a standalone compressed deformation model
